summary: Project includes a Live List Checking app with a comment generator, adding a rule to allow only one comment per list per device for all users.
architectural_notes: Need a per-device identifier and storage to enforce 'one comment per list per device' across all users (e.g., deviceId + listId uniqueness).

existing_features.title: Update the Customer View single comment generator UI to implement 'one comment per list per device' by generating/persisting a device identifier in browser local storage, using it when calling the backend single-comment API, and disabling the single-generate button (or showing an English error) when the device has already generated a single comment for the selected list.

new_feature_requests.summary: Enforce one comment per list per device (comment generator only), for all users; on repeat attempts disable button or show an error

Add backend enforcement so that, for the single-comment generator flow only, the same device can generate at most one comment per comment list; subsequent attempts for the same (device, listName) must fail with a clear error.

If the backend uses stable persisted state for comment generator data, add/extend the migration to initialize any new persisted structure needed to track per-(device, listName) single-generation usage without breaking existing deployments.
